semantic_review: Independent first agent checks before candidate inference, with exact source labels/provenance visible but no candidate responses. Human validation pending. Preserve first files and separate adjudication.
semantic_eligibility: Accept only recasts whose source gold reading supports the positive replacement and whose non-gold full replacement is not entailed. Retain valid contradiction negatives as well as neutral negatives; do not select only compatible negatives to maximize bad-label penalties. Reject grammar corruption, entailed alias cases and unresolved binary validity. Preserve all excluded/uncertain rows.
intended_reading_convention: Original unresolved source passage is transmitted. Official coreference gold fixes intended reading for analyst binary interpretation, not an official NLI label or a proof all arbitrary readings agree.
desired_size: Use all source-only semantically eligible passages up to80, deterministically selected before candidate outputs; aim64–80. If fewer than40 valid passages, do not treat as impact-grade execution without a separately reviewed redesign.
selection_confirmation: Disjoint source passage/similarity-family clusters assigned50/50 before candidate outputs. Preserve cross-variant dependency and source-cluster bootstrap. No source passage duplicated between selection and confirmation.
primary_comparison: Same frozen3way predictions scored by literal Q48 positive=entailment/negative=contradiction versus repaired directional-entailment binary scoring where neutral+contradiction=nonentailment. This isolates scoring-rule consequences conditional on fixed predictions, not causal real-user adoption.
secondary_three_way: Use independently confident analyst C/N labels only as a secondary sensitivity, with ambiguous labels retained/excluded transparently and no official NLI gold claim.
all_pairs: Report all6pairwise model comparisons and tied rankings. Select unique winning candidate by each rule on selection split; assess repaired binary accuracy difference on disjoint confirmation split. Ties indeterminate, negative/zero differences retained.
no_activation_reuse: New exploratory Q48 mechanism study; failed historical PAWS gate is unchanged and not reused.

prospective_discovery_exclusion_addendum.reason: Prior discovery-witness independence; no candidate outputs exist.
prospective_discovery_exclusion_addendum.rule: Exclude entire connected similarity family containing either prior discovery witness W074 or its near-identical W001 skeptical variant. Same fixed family rule governs split/resampling.
prospective_discovery_exclusion_addendum.cluster_rule: Casefold and collapse whitespace; edge if max forward/reverse SequenceMatcher ratio with autojunk=False >=0.80; connected components on all81 source-only mechanical rows.
